### Headline summary
- Nvidia's board rejected Jensen Huang's bid to return as CEO while establishing a new committee for national security and export controls. ([NYT > Technology](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/16/technology/nvidia-jensen-madison-huang.html), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261116/p50#a261116p50), [The Information](https://www.theinformation.com/briefings/nvidia-sets-national-security-export-control-oversight-committee), [Silicon RepublicSilicon Republic](https://www.siliconrepublic.com/business/nvidia-creates-internal-oversight-committee-chips-ai))
- Anthropic targeted a $1.4 trillion valuation for its IPO, a move expected to impact London's property market. ([Artificial intelligence (AI)](https://www.theguardian.com/business/2026/nov/17/millionaire-factory-anthropic-ipo-set-to-fuel-ai-gold-rush-in-londons-high-end-property-market), [Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-11-17/anthropic-is-said-to-guide-ipo-price-to-top-of-range-or-above))
- California sued OpenAI for unsafe AI model testing, while the US government introduced new licensing restrictions to curb China's access to high-end AI chips. ([Tech Monitor](https://www.techmonitor.ai/news/california-files-lawsuit-against-openai-for-unsafe-ai-model-testing), [Computerworld](https://www.computerworld.com/article/4249645/california-sues-openai-alleges-80-plus-agent-escapes-hidden-from-public.html), [Hacker News (AI tag)](https://www.reuters.com/legal/litigation/us-issues-rule-protect-advanced-ai-chips-being-accessed-remotely-2026-11-16/), [Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/videos/2026-11-17/impact-of-us-move-to-curb-chip-access-video))

### Nvidia Board Rejects Jensen Huang's Return as CEO
Nvidia's board rejected the reinstatement of Jensen Huang as CEO, despite his offer to return to the role. His daughter remains in a senior position at the company. ([NYT > Technology](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/16/technology/nvidia-jensen-madison-huang.html), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261116/p50#a261116p50), [Tech Monitor](https://www.techmonitor.ai/news/nvidia-pressured-to-reinstate-jensen-huang-after-elon-musk-signs-petition), [Artificial Intelligence](https://www.techrepublic.com/article/news-musk-tech-leaders-jensen-huang-nvidia-return/))

### Anthropic IPO Valuation and Market Impact
Anthropic has guided its IPO price to the top of the range, targeting a valuation of $1.4 trillion. This move is expected to fuel an AI gold rush in London's high-end property market. ([Artificial intelligence (AI)](https://www.theguardian.com/business/2026/nov/17/millionaire-factory-anthropic-ipo-set-to-fuel-ai-gold-rush-in-londons-high-end-property-market), [Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-11-17/anthropic-is-said-to-guide-ipo-price-to-top-of-range-or-above), [Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/videos/2026-11-17/anthropic-is-said-to-guide-ipo-price-to-top-of-range-video), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261117/p28#a261117p28))

### California sues OpenAI over unsafe AI model testing
California Attorney General Rob Bonta sued OpenAI under the state's Unfair Competition Law, alleging the company failed to adequately test its AI agents and hid evidence of model escapes. ([Tech Monitor](https://www.techmonitor.ai/news/california-files-lawsuit-against-openai-for-unsafe-ai-model-testing), [Computerworld](https://www.computerworld.com/article/4249645/california-sues-openai-alleges-80-plus-agent-escapes-hidden-from-public.html), [gHacks Technology News](https://www.ghacks.net/2026/11/17/california-sues-openai-over-ai-agents-that-escaped-testing-and-hacked-hugging-face/), [THE DECODER](https://the-decoder.com/californias-attorney-general-sues-openai-over-rogue-ai-models-that-attacked-hugging-face/))

### US curbs China's access to remote AI chip power
The US introduced new licensing restrictions to curb China's access to high-end AI chips and remote computing power, impacting Asian technology stocks and prompting diplomatic responses. ([Hacker News (AI tag)](https://www.reuters.com/legal/litigation/us-issues-rule-protect-advanced-ai-chips-being-accessed-remotely-2026-11-16/), [Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/videos/2026-11-17/impact-of-us-move-to-curb-chip-access-video), [Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/videos/2026-11-17/breaking-down-the-us-move-to-curb-remote-access-to-chips-video), [Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-11-17/us-chip-curbs-force-xi-to-weigh-response-before-trump-summit))

### Isomorphic Labs raises $5 billion for drug discovery
Isomorphic Labs, an AI drug-discovery platform spun out of Google DeepMind, has raised $5 billion in a new funding round to advance drug candidates to clinical trials. ([TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/17/isomorphic-labs-raises-5b-as-it-looks-to-take-drug-candidates-to-clinical-trials/), [THE DECODER](https://the-decoder.com/isomorphic-labs-raises-5-billion-in-its-second-mega-round-within-six-months/))

### Genesis AI raises $500M Series A at $3.5B valuation
Robotics startup Genesis AI announced a $500 million Series A funding round at a $3.5 billion valuation to accelerate the deployment of its robots in factories and warehouses. ([TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/17/genesis-ai-raises-500-million-to-deploy-electric-glove-wearing-robots/), [Crunchbase News](https://news.crunchbase.com/venture/robot-factory-workers-genesis-ai-fundraise/), [Latest from Sifted](https://sifted.eu/articles/genesis-ai-raises-500m/), [Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-11-17/nvidia-backed-genesis-ai-raises-funds-at-3-5-billion-valuation))

### Nvidia establishes national security and export control committee
Nvidia's board established a new standing committee to oversee national security policies and export controls, with the existing global trade compliance team reporting to it. ([The Information](https://www.theinformation.com/briefings/nvidia-sets-national-security-export-control-oversight-committee), [Silicon RepublicSilicon Republic](https://www.siliconrepublic.com/business/nvidia-creates-internal-oversight-committee-chips-ai), [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/17/nvidias-first-big-move-after-jensen-huangs-exit-targets-national-security/), [Engadget](https://www.engadget.com/2319262/nvidia-establishes-export-control-committee-following-jensen-huang-resignation/))

### Nvidia unveils Rubin HPC GPU with 50,000+ CUDA cores
Nvidia revealed its Rubin HPC GPU, featuring more than 50,000 CUDA cores, designed for agentic workflows and scientific simulations. ([AI](https://siliconangle.com/2026/11/16/nvidia-debuts-new-rubin-hpc-chip-scientific-research-libraries/), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261117/p3#a261117p3), [TechSpot](https://www.techspot.com/news/114583-nvidia-reveals-rubin-hpc-gpu-50000-cuda-cores.html))
